name: FileRawData
description: Raw text data attached to a file — extracted text, OCR output, parsed content. Indexed by fileId and a type discriminator so multiple representations can coexist for one file. ACL is read-only via generic CRUD: writes are produced by the parse / OCR / extraction pipelines on the service side.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owner — denormalized from the parent File2 (52-D doc). representsOwnership drives the ownership filter.

attributes.name: raw
attributes.description: stores raw data json (not processed using post processors)
